Title: Action required: Review your applications to avoid service disruption during Azure changes

Body.Content:
As of August 13, 2020, Azure services are being updated in a phased approach to use Transport Layer Security (TLS) certificates from a different set of Root Certificate Authorities (CAs). 

Action required:

  • Review our Azure TLS Cert document which provides background and guidance to determine if your applications will be impacted, and to mitigate, if needed.
